description: This script is a log parser for dictionary-based logging, utilizing a JSON database to decode binary log data and print log messages. It handles command-line arguments for file inputs and options, reads log data in various formats, and uses a parser obtained from the dictionary_parser module to process the logs.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for database file, log file, and options.

methods.name: read_log_file
methods.description: Reads log data from file, handling hex and binary formats.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates log parsing process, including setup, reading files, and invoking the parser.
